title: Standard MP Protocol for Genealogy Dilutions
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Create input CSV file
steps.instruction: Prepare a `.csv` file that follows the provided template, specifying the number of samples, the mount side for the P300 multi‑channel pipette, the initial bead transfer volume in µL, and the bead separation time in minutes.

steps.title: Download generated protocol
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons protocol generator, upload the CSV file and download the resulting protocol script.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons App, select “Upload Protocol”, and import the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck exactly as shown in the deck map, placing the following labware:

substeps.instruction: P300 and P1000 single‑channel GEN2 electronic pipettes on their designated mounts.
Opentrons 300 µL tip rack for the P300 and 1000 µL tip rack for the P1000.
Opentrons 4‑in‑1 tube rack containing NEST 1.5 mL snap‑cap tubes, 15 mL tubes, and 50 mL tubes.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, run the calibration routine for each piece of labware, tip racks, and both pipettes using the supplied calibration tips.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: After calibration, return to the protocol screen and press “Run” to execute the genealogy dilutions.
